answer: An orchard survey renews access through annotation work: each identity gets fresh, disjoint photos and must outline the ivory blossoms. Reviewers check polygon vertex placement, and an image can earn credit only once. Software can be shared, but added identities still require separate accepted annotations. Example: at 40 verified outlines per identity every 7 days, maintaining 25 fake identities costs 1,000 distinct verified outlines of annotation work per week.
